rationale: The plan uses the right test family (DESeq2 Wald plus edgeR QL, three per group, no blocking, low-power statement without lowering alpha) but never infers strandedness; it replaces the check with a sensitivity analysis built on a false premise, since a stranded library counted with the wrong -s (or an unstranded one counted as stranded) changes nearly every gene's count, not only opposite-strand overlappers, so the 'strand-unambiguous' rerun does not resolve the user's doubt about the counts as delivered. QC (vst PCA, distances, library sizes) is named but lacks an outlier or shallow-sample policy and coloring by condition. Filter (10 counts in 3 samples), median-of-ratios normalization, named reference level and contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm are all stated, though the design formula itself is not written out. Enrichment is correctly omitted; the report step names versions and the strand-dependence caveat but only Step 1 is fully specified, leaving the DE steps described in narrative alone.
